row.end_state_problems: provider URL is internal://payments-v2; 20 processed orders unpaid

summary.root_cause_text: The ops config change moved payment_provider_url from internal://payments-v1 to internal://payments-v2, and v2 is unreachable. Every payment call fails silently and the orders are marked processed with no payment.
recommended: Revert payment_provider_url to internal://payments-v1, or fix connectivity to payments-v2. The operator rejected my set_config revert.
Once payments work, run reprocess_orders on all_unpaid to pay the 20 affected orders.
Do not restart the worker until payments work, or the queue will be processed without payment.
Verify with check_invariants after the fix.
